sentences.en: The television show was interrupted by a special news report.
sentences.zh: 电视节目被特别新闻报道中断了。

sentences.en: I had hardly opened my mouth, when she interrupted me.
sentences.zh: 我刚开口，她就打断了我。

sentences.en: Excuse me for interrupting, I've got something to tell you.
sentences.zh: 对不起打扰一下，我有件事要告诉你。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：inter（在…之间）+rupt（破，断裂）→在中间断裂→中断，中止
